title: Typed Link
definition: A directed relationship between two Substrate records carrying a type (e.g., `applied-by`, `supersedes`, `parallel-to`, `cross-project-evidence`) and note text explaining the specific relationship. The type set is extensible: the spike's four starting types covered roughly half the relationships five ADRs needed (C4). Subject to Note Discipline.

links.note: constraint 1: any string is a valid link type
